purpose: Held-out .08 and .10 continuation of the frozen late-rate candidate; no optimization or proof claim
resolution_rule: Individual trajectories may reach .10 if their own cutoff and invariant gates pass. A failed pair is not promoted; if needed, run the same initial coefficients from t=0 on grid 128 and assess 64/128. Stop resolution escalation at 128 in this campaign.
validation: Run the independent radix2/FFTW full trajectory on grid 64 through .10; rerun grid 64 from t=0 with a materially smaller timestep and .005 observations, comparing common physical times. These do not constitute a full grid-128 timestep or independent-trajectory test.
interpretation: All thresholds are empirical finite-amplification screening criteria. Positive finite sampled growth and small retained-edge energy do not certify a PDE singularity or bound absent Fourier modes.
